demos.name: Aggregate entitlement lab
demos.description: See how an MCP aggregate lists only the tools each caller may use and refuses the rest by name: six checks, guided steps and a diagram. Mock simulates the Ping release claim (UNVERIFIED on our tenant); Real measures your own gateway's aggregate apps with your agent keys.
demos.notes: Host-run: npm run build, then npm start (port 7802, loopback only). Docker: HOST_PORT=7802 docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:7802 only). Mock needs nothing. Real: set AGG_ENT_GW_URL, AGG_ENT_GW_APPS and AGG_ENT_GW_KEY_<NAME> in ~/Development/.env, then use the Real toggle. Fork of mcp-tools-LAB (its Entitled listing page). No catalog row matches, so no catalogId; the owner assigns one with the board row. composeFile is relative to the shelf's demo root.
